readme.text:
This is a mod the 'The Escapists 2' for use with Archipelago, the Multi World Randomiser. 

# Installing the APworld:
Download and install the way you usually would, no extra files required.

Repo here: https://github.com/BigCelery842906/TE2Archipelago/

# Installing the mod:
Extract the zip into the root of your game directory, such that your Escapists2 folder looks like so:
- TheEscapists2 root folder
    - BepInEx (folder)
    - .doorstop_version
    - doorstop_config.ini
    - winhttp.dll
    - TheEscapists2.exe
    - (Other Escapists2 Files)


# How does The EscAPists 2 work for Archipelago?

Each prison gets randomised into the pool, putting checks for escapes, jobs, stats and random items into the pool0

## Locations:
Desks 

Job Checks 

Each Prison Escape 

Stat Checks (Strength, Stamina and Intelligence) 

## Items:
Certain Blueprints required for escapes

Progressive Stats

Prison unlocks

Random Items

## Goal Condition:
Set the number of unique escapes you must complete before you can goal

# Extra Features:
DeathLink - The DeathLink you all know and love

StealthLink - If you trigger a lockdown in your prison, everyone else with the setting enabled gets one too!

Payphone Hints - Pay some money into a payphone and you'll get a random hint!

# Future Features:
Favour Checks

DLC Prisons

Connecting via the game rather than the bridge

notes.text:
What's Changed:

Client:
Fixed an index issue with Rattlesnake Springs Desk Checks
The bridge now also outputs a log file for easier debugging
Game no longer spits out error messages while waiting on a bridge connection
The bridge will now show the text from the server instead of 3 statements for every check
Fixed Breathable Trash Bag Blueprint not working

APWorld:
Rattlesnake Springs Desk 36 is no longer a thing (Miscount goes crazy)
3 Desks in USS Anomaly have been updated to require a red key now (Namely 15, 19 and 23)
Super Whip Blueprint is now classed as progressive due to use in the Rock Hammer Hard Place Fort Tundra Escape
Lightweight Cutters are now put into the item pool
